clue.text: In conclusion, severe irritation is making life hazardous

indicators.note: the word for severe irritation is placed inside the word for conclusion

parts.note: an ending is a conclusion
anger is severe irritation

explanation.surface: Someone at the end of their tether finds that rage is making life dangerous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' looks like the start of the phrase 'in conclusion', but it is the container signal: ANGER goes inside ENDING.
explanation.definitionFit: To endanger is to put at risk, so making life hazardous is threatening it.

clue.text: Material used to make hose

parts.note: hose here means stockings, not a garden pipe: a synthetic fibre that stockings are woven from

explanation.definitionFit: Stockings, called hose, are commonly made of this synthetic polymer fibre.

clue.text: This might mean one has made a bloomer

indicators.note: the letters of the words mean one have been made into something new by rearrangement

explanation.surface: Somebody has blundered, perhaps by being unkind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a blunder, but here it is literally a thing that blooms, a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a flowering plant, so it is something that blooms.

clue.text: Grumble about game

explanation.surface: Someone complains about a match or the shooting season.
explanation.definitionFit: To complain is to moan; the bird of that name is shot as game on British moors.

clue.text: Withdraws into alcoves

explanation.surface: Someone retreats into nooks in a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A body that goes into recess withdraws from business; recesses are also niches set back in a wall.

clue.text: Irritated by a sharp note

parts.note: a needle is something sharp
D is a note of the musical scale

explanation.surface: Someone is annoyed by a piercing musical tone.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle someone is to provoke or annoy them, so needled means annoyed.

clue.text: Man who swam the channel both ways was cheating!

definitions.text: Man who swam the channel both ways was cheating!

parts.words: Man who swam the channel both ways was cheating!
parts.note: a swimmer crossing the English Channel there and back has crossed it twice, and a person who betrays a partner is a cheat

explanation.surface: A celebrated cross-Channel swimmer is accused of foul play.
explanation.definitionFit: A traitor who betrays an ally is a cheat; literally someone who crosses twice.

clue.text: Severe young man found at the very back of the boat

definitions.text: found at the very back of the boat

parts.note: stern means severe
a son is a young man

explanation.surface: A strict youth is discovered in the rearmost part of a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: The stern is also the back of a boat, which makes the surface neat.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a timber reinforcing the stern post, so it sits at the rear of a vessel.

clue.text: Soldier who carries a spear on his body

parts.note: a lance is a spear
corporal means relating to the body, as in corporal punishment

explanation.surface: A warrior bears a lance upon his person.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the lowest non-commissioned rank in the British Army, so a type of serviceman.

clue.text: Low flying bird

indicators.note: letters sent flying are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A bird skims close to the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: This nocturnal raptor is a kind of bird.

clue.text: Rector has organised a band…

indicators.note: letters that are organised are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A vicar has formed a musical group in his parish.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a large group of instrumental musicians, a kind of musical ensemble.

clue.text: … they might play bits with Jason

indicators.note: letters that might play about are free to rearrange themselves

explanation.surface: Musicians perhaps perform pieces alongside someone called Jason.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this to the previous clue: 'they' refers to members of the band.
explanation.definitionFit: These players of a stringed instrument are musicians, the 'they' who play.

clue.text: Melodious verse

explanation.surface: Poetry that is tuneful.
explanation.definitionFit: A lyrical sound is songlike and tuneful; the words of a song are also called its lyric.

clue.text: Use this to lead the fish a dance

definitions.text: Use this to lead the fish

explanation.surface: An angler's gear leads a fish on a merry chase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead the fish a dance' is an idiom for giving trouble, but it splits into the angler's winding device and a Scottish dance.
explanation.definitionFit: An angler winds line on a spool of this name; it is also a lively Scottish folk dance.

clue.text: Sailor and artist somehow scraping a living

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword abbreviation for artist

indicators.note: somehow says the letters of sailor come out in some other order

explanation.surface: A seaman and a painter barely manage to get by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scraping a living' reads as being poor, but it literally describes birds such as hens scratching the ground for food.
explanation.definitionFit: The zoological term describes fowl that scratch at the soil when foraging.

clue.text: The first German diocese to have a measure of the earth

indicators.note: only the initial letter of the word German is taken
a thin signal: the diocese is to have its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: The earliest German bishopric owns a surveying instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: There is no strong anagram signal; 'to have' must serve as the hint that DIOCESE is rearranged into EODESIC after the G.
explanation.definitionFit: Geodesy is the science of measuring the planet, and the adjective names lines or surveys measured over its curved surface.

clue.text: A marine in charge of the committee has a comfortable seat

parts.note: RM stands for Royal Marines
the chair is the person running a committee

explanation.surface: A soldier chairing a committee gets a cosy seat.
explanation.definitionFit: This upholstered seat with side rests is a comfy chair.

clue.text: They make little noise while stealing

definitions.text: They make little noise while stealing

parts.words: They make little noise while stealing
parts.note: something that makes a soft crackling sound, and people who steal cattle

explanation.surface: Quiet thieves creep about.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaves or paper make a soft crackle, and in the Wild West cattle thieves went by this name.

clue.text: Illuminate from below?

parts.note: to illuminate is to shine on, and from below the light would be directed upward

explanation.definitionFit: To switch on lamps is to illuminate, and the adverb adds a direction.

clue.text: Green stuff

explanation.surface: Grass, or vegetation in general.
explanation.definitionFit: A grassed garden area is a green; it is also a fine linen cloth, and stuff is old word for fabric.

clue.text: Are called in to make preparations

indicators.note: the word for called is put inside the word are

parts.note: rang means telephoned, called

explanation.surface: Visitors are summoned to get things ready.
explanation.definitionFit: To organise in advance is to set things in order beforehand.

clue.text: Purpose of accommodation at camp

explanation.surface: Someone asks what the point of a camping site is.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into IN TENT: what you are in when accommodated at a camp.
explanation.definitionFit: An aim is a purpose; and campers sleeping under canvas are housed inside their shelter.

clue.text: Twig that there is no point in making a jump

indicators.note: no says the compass point letter is absent from the jump

parts.note: a spring is a leap, a jump
N is the compass point north

explanation.surface: Someone realises there's no sense in leaping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twig' looks like the verb meaning to realise, but it is the noun, a small shoot.
explanation.definitionFit: A small shoot of a plant is a little twig.

clue.text: She is happy with quite a low score

definitions.text: She is happy with quite a low score

parts.words: She is happy with quite a low score
parts.note: score here is a piece of written music, and a low one suits a woman with a deep voice

explanation.definitionFit: This is the lowest female singing voice, comfortable with low-pitched music.

clue.text: Go away on holiday

explanation.surface: Depart on vacation.
explanation.definitionFit: To depart is to go; time off work granted by an employer is also called this.

clue.text: Have the right money and demand food

parts.note: to exact is to demand
fare means food, as in good plain fare

explanation.surface: A diner pays correctly and insists on being fed.
explanation.walkthrough: On a bus, passengers are asked to have the precise coins ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Bus passengers were asked to tender precisely the cost of the ticket, no change given.

clue.text: Lady who had a part

indicators.note: a part of the words had a supplies the name

explanation.surface: A woman who had a role in a play.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a woman's name, as in Ada Lovelace.

clue.text: It enables one to go straight

definitions.text: It enables one to go straight

parts.words: It enables one to go straight
parts.note: going straight suggests a reformed criminal, but here it means making things true and level

explanation.definitionFit: This builder's tool uses a bubble in liquid to show a surface is truly horizontal.
